mode: Review with blockers and suggestions in a fixed bullet format.

checks.name: format
checks.criterion: Every finding bullet matches the B/S status/action/name/description/fix/why format, with at least one B and one S.

checks.name: status-open
checks.criterion: No finding claims status FIXED, because the model applied no change.

checks.name: no-em-dash
checks.criterion: The message holds no em-dash outside code.

checks.name: no-flattery
checks.criterion: The message holds no flattery or filler phrase from a fixed list.
